page_title: KOR 2-1 POR | South Korea v Portugal 02/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Substitution. Yu-Min Cho (South Korea) replaces Gue-Sung Cho.
90+2' The game is interrupted. Hee-Chan Hwang (South Korea) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.

90+1' 2 - 1 Superb finishing from Hee-Chan Hwang (South Korea). Heung-Min Son plays a fantastic through ball and finds Hee-Chan Hwang (South Korea), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goal and fire a low shot from close range past the goalkeeper. It's 2:1.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Portugal.
88' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
86' The ball goes behind for a corner. Portugal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
86' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
81' That's the end of the game for Joao Mario, who is replaced by William Carvalho (Portugal).
81' Fernando Santos prepares a substitution. Vitinha is replaced by Bernardo Silva (Portugal).
81' The game has come to an end for Kang-In Lee. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ui-Jo Hwang (South Korea).
81' The substitution is prepared. Jun-Ho Son (South Korea) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Young-Gwon Kim.
79' Looks like Young-Gwon Kim (South Korea) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
78' Ricardo Horta (Portugal) dribbles into the box, but Seung-Gyu Kim is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
77' Diogo Dalot (Portugal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
74' Kang-In Lee (South Korea) produces a shot from a long-range free kick, but it flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Portugal.
73' Facundo Tello blows the whistle, Joao Palhinha (Portugal) is penalised for a foul. South Korea earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
72' A thunderous effort from long range by Rafael Leao (Portugal) goes well wide of the left post.
71' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
71' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
69' Rafael Leao (Portugal) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Facundo Tello who sees an offensive foul.
69' Diogo Costa blocks In-Beom Hwang (South Korea)'s effort from the edge of the box.
65' It is time for a substitution. Hee-Chan Hwang (South Korea) is on for Jae-Sung Lee.
65' Here's the change. Matheus Nunes leaves the pitch and Joao Palhinha (Portugal) comes on as a substitute.
65' Fernando Santos decides to make a substitution. Ruben Neves will be replaced by Rafael Leao (Portugal).
65' Andre Silva (Portugal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Cristiano Ronaldo.
62' Vitinha (Portugal) tries to find Cristiano Ronaldo with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
58' The free kick from long range, taken by South Korea, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Portugal.
57' Jae-Sung Lee (South Korea) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Portugal.
56' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
56' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
56' Diogo Dalot (Portugal) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
54' Jae-Sung Lee (South Korea) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
52' The linesman raises his flag. Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) is adjudged offside.
50' Joao Cancelo (Portugal) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
47' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) is flagged for offside.
47' The Portugal players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Referee Facundo Tello blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Joao Mario (Portugal) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Ricardo Horta (Portugal) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Seung-Gyu Kim is well positioned to make a comfortable save.

42' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) blows a golden opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He pounces on the rebound to head the ball just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and South Korea will have a goal kick.

42' Vitinha (Portugal) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!

41' What a poor attempt! Matheus Nunes (Portugal) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for South Korea.

41' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Diogo Costa was ready and made a save.
37' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
36' Facundo Tello shows a yellow card to Kang-In Lee (South Korea) for a tough tackle.
36' Jin-Su Kim (South Korea) sends a cross into the box, but Diogo Costa comes off his line to gather the ball.
35' Joao Mario (Portugal) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

35' Diogo Dalot (Portugal) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Seung-Gyu Kim! The linesman points to the corner flag, Portugal are going to take it.
30' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) heads on.
27' 1 - 1 Young-Gwon Kim (South Korea) collects the ball deep inside the box from a rebound following the corner kick. He beats the keeper with a sharp low shot in the middle! Quite a nice goal!
27' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
27' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by South Korea, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to South Korea.
26' A player from Portugal pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. South Korea win a free kick.
24' An attempted cross from Matheus Nunes (Portugal) is cleared.
22' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
20' Woo-Young Jung (South Korea) sends a long ball forward to Heung-Min Son, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Portugal will have a goal kick.
17' A goal, which was scored by Jin-Su Kim (South Korea), was disallowed due to offside.
16' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
15' A pass from Joao Cancelo (Portugal) is intercepted by Seung-Gyu Kim and the move breaks down.
12' Jae-Sung Lee (South Korea) is penalised for holding. Facundo Tello signals a set piece.
12' Portugal are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
8' In-Beom Hwang (South Korea) tries to find Jin-Su Kim, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball has crossed the sideline. Portugal are taking a throw-in.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! Diogo Dalot passes the ball to the feet of Ricardo Horta (Portugal), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 0:1.
4' Joao Cancelo (Portugal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Seung-Gyu Kim intercepts the ball.
2' South Korea spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake.
1' Antonio Silva (Portugal) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
1' The first half has just begun.
South Korea will kick-off.
Facundo Tello will officiate today.
